text: An autokey grows its key from the text itself, so a hand slip is easy: a wrong letter, or losing one's place in the chain. Earlier tests threw away any setting that missed one known letter.

Ciphertext autokey on every table tried so far (487,734 setups), every lag, up to 2 slips or one lost step; the progressive key on the sculpture's tables with up to 2 slips; K4 against 20 scrambled copies, readings judged blind, five planted slipped messages.
Nothing fits K4 below lag 68 (copies 67-69), where 6 or fewer checks are left; the progressive key nowhere below period 25. K4's best reading scores 4, the copies' 12; all five plants are found.
